say:1:1123624001:1.text: Two days ago, a group of warriors-in-training traveled to the desert for their trial.
say:1:1123624001:1.source_cn: 前两天，有一批实习战士前往沙漠，进行成为战士的正式试炼。

say:2:1123624002:1.text: But I just found out that an accident took place during their trial. Several warriors went missing amidst a sandstorm.
say:2:1123624002:1.source_cn: 但我刚刚得知，试炼的途中发生了意外。有几名战士在沙暴中...

say:3:1123624003:1.text: Those who made it back sustained heavy injuries, so they can't go out again to find the others. I really need your help in locating our <style="highlight">missing warriors</style>.
say:3:1123624003:1.source_cn: 回来的那些人也都受了不少伤，暂时无法再出去寻人。所以我...
say:3:1123624003:1.male: Those who made it back sustained heavy injuries, so they can't go out again to find the others. I really need your help in locating our <style="highlight">missing warriors</style>.
say:3:1123624003:1.female: Those who made it back sustained heavy injuries, so they can't go out again to find the others. I really need your help in locating our <style="highlight">missing warriors</style>.

say:4:1123624004:1.text: The sandstorm happened near the <style="highlight">south side of the desert</style>. I'm counting on you, Magister.
say:4:1123624004:1.source_cn: 出现沙暴的地方就在<style=highlight>南...
say:4:1123624004:1.male: The sandstorm happened near the <style="highlight">south side of the desert</style>. I'm counting on you, Magister.
say:4:1123624004:1.female: The sandstorm happened near the <style="highlight">south side of the desert</style>. I'm counting on you, Magister.

say:0:1123625001:0.text: Look, Magister! Two Grimmaw warriors fighting a wild wolf!
say:0:1123625001:0.source_cn: 主人快看！前面那两个在和魔物战斗的人好像就是黑嚎的战士！
say:0:1123625001:0.male: Look, Magister! Two Grimmaw warriors fighting a wild wolf!
say:0:1123625001:0.female: Look, Magister! Two Grimmaw warriors fighting a wild wolf!

say:1:1123625002:0.text: They seem to be injured! Let's give them a hand!
say:1:1123625002:0.source_cn: 他们似乎受伤了，我们快去帮忙吧！

say:0:1123626001:0.text: Finally, we're safe! I knew Kruger would send someone to find us!
say:0:1123626001:0.source_cn: 终于得救了！我就知道克鲁格会派人来找我们！

say:1:1123626002:0.text: Our friend, Zane, went to scout but hasn't returned! We need to find him!
say:1:1123626002:0.source_cn: 对了，我们的同伴萨恩去寻路了，但一直没回来！我们得想办...

say:2:1123626003:0.text: My <style="highlight">terrabird</style> is good at finding people, but it went missing also... Let's find it as well.
say:2:1123626003:0.male: My <style="highlight">terrabird</style> is good at finding people, but it went missing also... Let's find it as well.
say:2:1123626003:0.female: My <style="highlight">terrabird</style> is good at finding people, but it went missing also... Let's find it as well.

say:0:1123627001:0.text: Great, I'll have my terrabird find Zane!
say:0:1123627001:0.source_cn: 太好了，我这就让陆行鸟去找萨恩！

say:1:1123627002:0.text: Go ahead and follow my terrabird. We'll catch up after dressing our wounds.
say:1:1123627002:0.source_cn: 你们先跟着陆行鸟去找人，等我们包扎完伤口就跟上！

say:0:1123628001:0.text: AHHHH! Where did all these <style="highlight">bugs</style> come from?

say:1:1123628002:0.text: Help me get rid of them!
say:1:1123628002:0.source_cn: 快、快！帮我把它们抓出来！！

say:3:1123629002:1.text: I'm fine! It's just that those annoying bugs are crawling all over my fur and refuse to come out!
say:3:1123629002:1.source_cn: 已经没事了！都怪那群讨厌的小虫子，爬进毛里就不肯出来了！

say:4:1123629003:1.text: That's good. Let's take a break and then carry on with the trial.
say:4:1123629003:1.source_cn: 那就好。我们休息一阵，再继续完成试炼吧。

say:7:1123629004:1.text: What?! Do you all still want to continue even though you're injured?
say:7:1123629004:1.source_cn: 哎？！你们都受伤了，还要继续试炼吗？

say:8:1123629005:1.text: We expected to gain wounds and scars during the trial. It's a test to see how far we can go!
say:8:1123629005:1.source_cn: 在试炼中受伤不是常事吗！否则怎么考验我们的实力！

say:9:1123629006:1.text: We're ready to face anything that happens! Even death! This is what the trial means!
say:9:1123629006:1.source_cn: 就算是死于试炼之中，我们也绝无怨言！这就是试炼的意义！

say:0:1123630001:0.text: Chippy doesn't understand why they're doing this...
say:0:1123630001:0.source_cn: 满满真搞不懂他们的想法……明明让他们受伤的又不是试炼！

say:1:1123630002:0.text: We should head back and update Kruger.
say:1:1123630002:0.source_cn: 算了，我们还是尽早回去向克鲁格汇报吧！

say:1:1123631001:1.text: Those warriors want to carry on with the trial? ... Alright, I understand.
say:1:1123631001:1.source_cn: 那些战士还要继续试炼？\n……好，我知道了。

say:2:1123631002:1.text: Their determination and courage are admirable.
say:2:1123631002:1.source_cn: 他们能有这样的决心和勇气，着实令人佩服。

say:3:1123631003:1.text: Thanks for your help. Everyone is relieved to hear that they are safe and sound.
say:3:1123631003:1.source_cn: 多谢你的帮助。\n既然他们暂时平安无恙，氏族的大家也就...
say:3:1123631003:1.male: Thanks for your help. Everyone is relieved to hear that they are safe and sound.
say:3:1123631003:1.female: Thanks for your help. Everyone is relieved to hear that they are safe and sound.
